title: Saliba language (Papua New Guinea)
displaytitle: Saliba language (Papua New Guinea)

titles.display: Saliba language (Papua New Guinea)

extract: Saliba is an Oceanic language spoken on the islets off the southeastern tip of Papua New Guinea. There are approximately 2,500 speakers of Saliba. Significant documentation of the language was undertaken by the Saliba-Logea documentation project, and hundreds of audio-video resources can be found in the project archive.
